comparators.constant_ink: negative mean squared residual error to context column3
comparators.nuisance: negative mean squared standardized nuisance distance to context column3

image_contract: native JPEG bytes verified by SHA256; no enhancement/resampling/generative images; image operations below are measurements only
inference: operational retrieval thresholds, not causal p-values; correlated queries/decoys not independent replications; no chronology, time direction, reading order or split-block scoring even on pass
nuisance_regression: standardize nuisance features on calibration windows only, append page intercept indicators, fit RGB ink by ridge sum(XtX)+1*I with page intercepts unpenalized; standardize residual ink by calibration residual standard deviations floor1e-6
other_row_selection: held rows of same page at true_column6; nearest two to true target in standardized nuisance feature distance; no ink feature or score in selection; exclude own row
predictor: linear continuation of last two residual ink vectors across three window steps: r3+3*(r3-r2); score negative mean squared residual error
reproducibility: numeric features rounded to12decimal places before model; deterministic NumPy linear algebra; all-source hashes and prereg/code locks before extraction
row_eligibility: all context,true,same-rowdecoy windows pass fixed quality plus at least2 other held rows with valid column6; no rescue or alternate columns
tie_credit: fractional top1 within1e-12 of best score
